section.p: Senior Software Engineer – API, microservices, integration platforms, and workflow orchestration.

Senior software engineer with 25+ years of experience designing and operating backend systems, REST APIs, and integration platforms at scale. Strong focus on API design, microservice-oriented architectures, workflow orchestration, and DevOps practices. Author of an internal API workflow orchestration engine built in Ballerina, exposing schema-driven API scenarios via OpenAPI/Swagger UI, with dynamic response reuse and JSONPath-based execution. Live demo: http://www.tchatapi.org — Source code: https://github.com/sitedesc/bal_apps/tree/main/apps/chatapi.

li.p: API & Microservices – REST API design, OpenAPI/Swagger, contract-first approaches, API Platform, service-oriented and microservice architectures.
Workflow & API Orchestration – API workflow orchestration, message-oriented integrations, BPM/ESB-inspired patterns, schema-driven execution (SchemedTalks).
Backend Development – Ballerina, Java/J2EE, PHP/Symfony, Python; strong focus on maintainability, observability, and robustness.
Data & Storage – PostgreSQL, MySQL, XML databases (BaseX, eXist-db), search engines (Lucene, Vespa), data transformation pipelines.
Cloud & DevOps – Docker, AWS, Linux (Ubuntu, Alpine), CI/CD with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, environment automation.
Quality & Reliability – automated testing (API and browser-based), production monitoring, incident analysis, refactoring of legacy systems.
Cosmobilis – Chambéry, France
Jan 2023 – Present
Designed and evolved backend REST APIs and microservice-oriented integrations for high-traffic, multi-country automotive platforms.
Implemented API-based workflows integrating ERP (OpenFlex), CRM (Salesforce), marketplaces, search engines, and third-party services.
Led architecture evolution toward message-oriented and orchestrated API workflows, improving reliability and observability.
Set up and maintained CI/CD pipelines and Docker-based environments on AWS, running production workloads on Ubuntu.

p.strong: Author & Maintainer – API Workflow Orchestration PoC (tchatAPI)

li.p: Oct 2024 – Present
Designed and implemented an API workflow orchestration engine in Ballerina, executing typed and generic HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, PUT) defined as structured JSON workflows (“SchemedTalks”).
Exposed the orchestration engine via OpenAPI/Swagger UI for interactive execution and testing of complex API scenarios.
Implemented features such as response memorization, JSONPath-based data extraction, and dynamic reuse of previous responses across workflow steps.
Integrated OpenAI API as a managed request type to demonstrate AI-assisted API workflows and dynamic content generation.
Live SwaggerUI demo: http://www.tchatapi.org
Source code (monorepo): https://github.com/sitedesc/bal_apps/tree/main/apps/chatapi
